item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Lukas Iannone, Scranton Prep swimming
item.description: The Cavaliers senior captured gold and set meet records in the 200-yard individual medley and the 100 backstroke at the Les Richards Swimming Championships. In the 200 IM, he finished in 1:57.42, which broke the previous meet record of 1:57.99 set in 2016 by Scranton Prep’s Nico Lastauskas. In the 100 backstroke, Iannone finished in 52.60, breaking the meet and pool record of 53.12 set in 2020 by former PIAA Class 2A champion Peter Kawash of Lakeland. item.title: DISTRICT 2 BASKETBALL: Scranton Prep’s Doherty cousins filled with emotion as playoffs start
item.description: SCRANTON — Before every game, Jimmy Doherty takes a few minutes to himself, prays, and summons strength and guidance from his guardian angel. Not far from him, Packy Doherty watches over him as he has for almost seven years. Tragedy brought these cousins together, bonded like brothers. Lindsay Doherty, a beloved member of the community and Jimmy’s mother, died just after crossing the finish line of the Scranton Half Marathon in 2017. She was only 36 years old. item.title: UNIFIED SPORTS: League bocce championships set for Tuesday at North Pocono
item.description: Athletes are set to compete for the Northeast Region of Special Olympics Pennsylvania Unified league bocce championship at North Pocono High School.
